# itoroapps

> itoroapps is an independent studio that makes iPhone apps for Spanish as it is spoken in Spain (Castilian, also called European or Peninsular Spanish, vosotros included): léxito (a dictionary) and Verbisto (verb conjugation practice). Both are iPhone only; there is no Android or iPad version. Contact: hello@itoroapps.com. itoroapps is not related to iToro or eToro.

## léxito

léxito is a Spain Spanish dictionary for people who already read in Spanish (best from B1). It shows not only what a word means but how it lands: colloquial, slang, vulgar / taboo, derogatory, rare / dated, or Latin American rather than Spain. Tone/register labels appear on about 8,000 of 148,000 meanings; most meanings are everyday, neutral Spanish and carry no label. The whole dictionary works on the iPhone without internet.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26.5 or later. Interface in English and Spanish.
- Dictionary: 108,058 entries and 147,819 meanings, built on Wiktionary data (via kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0); word frequency from wordfreq. The norm is Spain; Latin American meanings are marked as such. Updated every three months, updates included.
- Labels: most come from Wiktionary (English and Spanish), brought into one RAE-style list. The warnings “careful: regional trap” (harmless in Spain, rude in parts of Latin America, e.g. coger) and “careful: false friend”, and the “in neutral speech: …” hint (e.g. carro → coche), are added by the léxito team.
- Meanings: an English translation for every meaning; a Spanish definition for about 62 % of meanings, most common words included. No Russian or other languages.
- Catching words: typing (misspellings forgiven), a photo of a paper page, a screenshot or photo from your library, sharing selected text from Safari or another app that shares text, or copy and paste. About 1.19 million conjugated forms open the dictionary form; about 17,900 multi-word expressions. Words you look up come back for review.
- Photos and text are processed on the device. No account, no ads, no AI or online translation inside the app; if a word is missing, the app links to the RAE dictionary.
- Your word library syncs through your own iCloud and can be exported.
- Price: free download. The first 14 days everything is open and nothing is charged. After that you keep up to 150 words for free (review, search, lists, widget and export keep working). léxito unlimited removes the word limit and adds extra app icons: a yearly subscription ($39.99/year in the US App Store) or a one-time lifetime purchase ($99.99 in the US). Prices differ by country. No monthly plan.
- Also useful for: people who learned Latin American Spanish and now live or study in Spain (regional traps such as coger), Erasmus and exchange students, viewers of series from Spain.
- Not for: beginners (A1–A2), anyone who needs Latin American Spanish as their norm, anyone who wants a course, grammar lessons, conjugation tables, pronunciation (there is no audio), an AI conversation partner, or translation of whole sentences and texts. No iPad or Android version.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6820599112

## Verbisto

Verbisto is an iPhone app for practising Spanish verb conjugation (Spanish from Spain, every person including vosotros). You type each verb form yourself; the app marks the letters that went wrong (the stem, the ending, the accent, the helper verb or the participle) and explains the rule for that one part. It is a different app from Verbito, Verbizo and Verbooster. Details: https://itoroapps.com/verbisto/llms.txt

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6836263523
